body:
I arrived in the US yesterday afternoon after a full and enjoyable time in the UK, which deserves a more thorough write-up, hopefully next week. Now I’m in Dallas for the What is Church? event in Dallas, where I’ll be speaking with Suzanne Stabile, Enuma Okoro, Ian Cron, and others. If you’re in the area, I hope you’ll come – more info here:

 http://lifeinthetrinityministry.com/whatischurch/annualconference
